evals.prompt: Use $verify-and-report-jira to verify a completed change against its issue, PR, repository, test output, and recorded manual scenarios. Prepare but do not publish the Jira update.
expectations: Maps requirements and preserved flows to direct evidence
Uses only VERIFIED, NOT TESTED, BLOCKED, and FAILED
Shows the exact draft and pauses before posting

evals.prompt: Use $verify-and-report-jira when focused tests pass but the full suite has failures. Draft an accurate verification comment.
expectations: Investigates whether broader failures are related, unrelated, or unresolved
Does not equate focused success with complete verification
Identifies missing manual and regression evidence

evals.prompt: Use $verify-and-report-jira to draft a comment. Only after a later explicit approval, post it to the exact issue and confirm visibility.
expectations: Treats only later explicit approval as authority
Re-reads the comment or issue and reports confirmed identifiers
